Experimental tests performed on Feb 14, 2026.

The tests were performed following the motor manufacturer recommendation, that's the reason all sorts of prop/motor/battery were not tried.

Many generic carbon props were so unbalanced that wasn't possible to balancing them using enamel (nail paint). For such unbalanced props I recommend putting washers in the blade holding screws. 

Tests with the Propdrive 4248  motor didn't follow the manufacture recommendation because using we don't have the props indicated for using with 4S battery.

It seems that fixed props are better than the generic folding ones. Try to get more with the correct specification. Consider to buy a 5S battery if the weight and cost permit.
